messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: High 5xx spike for /v1/generate (us-east-1). Alerts from synthetic checks and realtime telemetry.

alex g: acked. seeing ~15% 502s on gateway for the last 3m. customers reporting timeouts. rolling mitigation?

maria p: I'm on it. first glance: control plane accepted config writes; control plane API returns 200 for rollout. console still shows old config for several routes. potential state propagation lag.

kevin: Confirmed. `curl https://controlplane.internal/api/routes?env=prod` -> returns new route, `kubectl -n inference get configroute` on dataplane nodes still shows old hash.

alex g: paste logs?

maria p: sending snips.

maria p: ```
# control-plane log
2026-03-15T02:12:08Z INFO route-manager: applied route update id=rt-42 version=2026-03-15-0212
2026-03-15T02:12:09Z INFO pubsub: published route-change channel=routes shard=7
```

kevin: ```
# dataplane node (node-17) config loader
2026-03-15T02:12:10Z INFO config-sync: checking for updates
2026-03-15T02:12:10Z WARN config-sync: replication-lag=18000ms
2026-03-15T02:12:10Z INFO config-sync: no new updates applied
```

sanjay: Looks like replication lag between control-plane pubsub and dataplane subscribers. Could be overloaded NATS/Redis or consumer backpressure.

julia: Customer impact quick note: billing-runner, template customers in us-east-1 saw increased failures; support flagged 8 customers.

alex g: mitigation idea: force a config refresh on dataplane shards, and enable fallback routing to variant-B until sync catches up. runbook?

maria p: I'll try a targeted refresh for shard 7 first. command:```sh
curl -X POST "https://controlplane.internal/admin/force-refresh?shard=7" -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED"
```

ops-bot: runbook step triggered: force-refresh for shard=7 initiated by maria p. job id=fr-20260315-0213.

kevin: kicked the refresh. watching metrics.

alex g: also toggled routing fallback to variant-B for routes serving billing-runner. command:```json
{"route":"/v1/generate","fallback":"variant-B","expires_in":300}
```

ops-bot: policy change applied to shard=7 routes. change-id=chg-998.

sanjay: post-change snapshot from node-17: `config-hash=abc123` -> now `config-hash=def456` after refresh. 502s fell from 15% -> 3% in 90s.

incident-bot: Incident declared: INC-2026-0315-17. Severity: P1 -> paging acknowledged and oncall assigned.

alex g: good. handing off to oncall-2nd for monitoring and RCA writeup. oncall-2nd, please own timeline + hypothesis tracking.

oncall-2nd: taking. I'll open a timeline thread in the doc and compile logs.

maria p: preliminary hypothesis: control-plane -> pubsub publish succeeded, but dataplane consumers experienced transient backpressure caused by a burst of config writes + heavy request load; replication delay caused stale config to serve and mismatch with console. secondary hypothesis: config cache TTL not invalidated on some nodes due to race with leader election.

julia: we should check the config-store (etcd) leader churn around 02:11-02:13. correlate with autoscaler events for dataplane pods.

kevin: pulling leader/raft logs now. snippets:```text
2026-03-15T02:11:59Z WARN raft: heartbeat timeout, starting election
2026-03-15T02:12:01Z INFO raft: new leader node-3 term=42
```

maria p: that aligns. leader change at 02:12 likely coincided with pubsub fanout. replication backlog increased.

sanjay: root cause candidate: simultaneous leader election + config burst -> pubsub queue backlog -> consumer lag -> stale config on dataplane -> console shows new config because control-plane is authoritative.

alex g: action items for RCA: 1) gather full pubsub backlog metrics (per-shard) 2) collect raft leader events and store them in timeline 3) verify consumer offset and restart behavior 4) propose mitigation: serialized config writes or backpressure protection + healthcheck gating config apply.

maria p: also propose adding a heartbeat-based immediate invalidation call for dataplane when leader flip occurs. short-term we can add a runbook step to force-refresh affected shards during leader election storms.

julia: support update: customer-impact list and severity updated in status page. created incident notice draft.

alex g: one more data point: telemetry traces show a surge in user-request QPS at 02:10-02:12 from a single high-throughput tenant. correlate with their traffic pattern.

oncall-2nd: I'm collecting all logs into the timeline doc: https://internal.docs/incidents/INC-2026-0315-17/timeline (bookmark). Please drop any raw logs there.

maria p: dropping pod logs for nodes node-13..node-18 and pubsub consumer offsets.

kevin: note for postmortem: quantify cost impact (tokens lost / retries), customer outage window (02:10-02:14 largely mitigated), and mitigations applied (force-refresh, fallback routing).

sanjay: temp fix validated. long-term fix candidates: - leader-stable config republish (wait for stable leader) - consumer-side config apply backoff / batching - add replication lag alarm.

alex g: thank you all. next steps: oncall-2nd will draft RCA skeleton with timeline + hypothesis and assign owners. we'll schedule a deep-dive with infra/serving next week.

julia: :thumbsup: I'll coordinate customer comms.

incident-bot: INC-2026-0315-17 updated: status=mitigated, severity downgraded to P2 post-mitigation.

oncall-2nd: handing back to alex g for closure if no further regressions in 30m. I'll keep the timeline doc open for RCA notes.

alex g: closing our live coord. please add any additional logs to timeline before 03:00Z. we'll convert to postmortem template after that.

maria p: adding final note: ran `kubectl rollout restart deployment/dataplane-consumers -n inference` as safety after refresh. observed steady-state restored.

kevin: saved command snippets and offsets in the timeline doc.

sanjay: adding suggested mitigations to backlog: INFRA-1243 (replication-lag alarm), RUNTIME-873 (force-refresh API runbook), SERVE-562 (config-apply gating).

alex g: thanks team. great run. :rocket:
